title: Review digest (model output of a review-digester, one unit)
description: digests/<unit>.json, written by the review-digester agent for one unit of the period (spec 047 ADR-4). Every entry names its sources. The stage-dependent checks (read_id, unit = file name, days = the unit's taking-part days, every source inside the unit, theme days inside the unit, section keys known, growth notes among the unit's created notes, the byte cap) are lib/review_digest.py's.

read_id.description: The read id the digester was given; must equal the read's.

unit.description: The unit name (a week, or <week>a, <week>b … of a split week); must equal the file name.

days.description: The unit's taking-part days, every one of them.
The days of the unit the theme shows on; a single day is allowed here (the two-day rule applies to the proposer's themes).

sections.description: Items per mapped section of the user's note: key is a row id of context.sections.

child_notes.description: What the unit's weekly note says; its source is the weekly note's stem.

growth.description: Candidates for the Vault growth group, condensed from the unit's growth/ files.

notes.description: Vault paths of notes created on the unit's days, as the growth/ files list them.

text.description: The condensed statement in the review language.

sources.description: Day stems or paths of the unit, or the unit's weekly note stem (child_notes).
